caption: Outcome-selected exploratory case RC2_10_3/B, route 15. The rule chose the lower-median customer count among 149 improving R2/RC2 holdout routes with changed topology and target attainment. Maps share equal aspect and identical bounds. S1, S2 and subsequent labels identify charging events in order on each plan. SUPPLEMENTARY_NOTES.md gives all station IDs, charge quantities and rates. Battery profiles use independently accumulated Euclidean distance on common physical scales. Full return is unconditional. This example illustrates a saved repair.

selection.rule: First parent, variant and route at lower median customer count in first nonempty tier. Tiers: improved + topology changed + attained in R2/RC2; same any family; improved + topology changed; improved; any route. All require at least 3 original visits.
